# Sine Integral

![Sine Integral function icon](../../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/exponential-integrals/02_Sinl.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../../index.md)

Evaluates Si(x)=integral(0,x,sin(t)/t,dt) in radians with signed x. Si(0)=0, Si(-1)=-0.946083070367183 and Si(+infinity)=pi/2.

Evaluates Si(x)=integral(0,x,sin(t)/t,dt) in radians with signed x. Si(0)=0, Si(-1)=-0.946083070367183 and Si(+infinity)=pi/2. Profile ni_documented_real_v1: Si uses signed x; En, Ci, Dilogarithm, Shi and Chi use q=abs(x). Standard Shi is odd, but the documented node adapter applies abs(x). En is E_n, not Ei; D(q)=-Li2(1-q), not Li2(q) or positive Spence. NI parity has not been measured. NI scalar real double baseline: x:f64, required scalar n:i32 for En, result:f64. FROG local Highlight extension through common NumericTreeMath maps real numeric x Arrays/Clusters while preserving rank, dimensions, typed empties and ordered field identities; n remains one required scalar i32 common to every x leaf. Real f32/integer x leaves promote visibly to f64, possibly rounding integers beyond 2^53. No implicit floating n conversion, truncation, absolute n, Boolean, String, Path, complex, Matrix or dimensional broadcasting. Native compiled provider is scalar only; aggregates fail explicitly. FROG numeric diagnostics use the existing channel without error terminals: nan_input, limit, domain, singularity, overflow, underflow, nonconvergence. Preserve typed NaN failures, signed zero, documented limiting infinities and representable subnormals. Scaled Shi/Chi evaluation avoids premature intermediate exp overflow at x=717.

## Types and connection rules

NI scalar real double baseline: x:f64, required scalar n:i32 for En, result:f64. FROG local Highlight extension through common NumericTreeMath maps real numeric x Arrays/Clusters while preserving rank, dimensions, typed empties and ordered field identities; n remains one required scalar i32 common to every x leaf. Real f32/integer x leaves promote visibly to f64, possibly rounding integers beyond 2^53. No implicit floating n conversion, truncation, absolute n, Boolean, String, Path, complex, Matrix or dimensional broadcasting. Native compiled provider is scalar only; aggregates fail explicitly.

- Type resolution: `custom_resolver`; result expression: `resolve:frog.studio.exponential-integrals.type-resolution@1`.
- Implicit coercion: permitted by this profile.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `element_wise_same_shape_with_scalar_lift`.
- Shape rule: `preserve_x_rank_dimensions_and_ordered_fields; n_is_scalar_common`.
- Scalar lifting: no.
- Broadcasting: no.

**Input count:** 1; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

Port order: `x`.
